title: French Cheese Gratin
description: A creamy, cheesy French dish with a crispy top, perfect for a comforting evening meal.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly.
In a saucepan, combine the grated cheese, butter, and paprika (if using).
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and smooth.
In a greased 20cm (8 inch) baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Pour some of the cheese mixture over the potatoes.
Repeat the potato and cheese layers, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Sprinkle the breadcrumbs over the cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
